scope: Factual, task-level dependencies for a bounded Lumbridge & Draynor and Kourend & Kebos diary utility pass. It records exact game mechanics and model boundaries; it does not rank diaries, select a route, or infer combat readiness.

facts_included: individual task requirements and exact spell inputs
claimed-tier reward behavior and repeat-use limits
deterministic item claims and zero-charge travel
explicit model boundaries for daily counters, combat events, and random outcomes
strategy_excluded: whether a player should pursue a reward

records.name: Lumbridge & Draynor task-level utility branches

requirements.claim_boundary: A claimed tier requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier. The account model records a claimed tier separately and does not infer it from the subset of task milestones below.

hard_bones_to_peaches_task.task: Cast Bones to Peaches in Al Kharid Palace.
hard_bones_to_peaches_task.spell_unlock: Mage Training Arena Bones to Peaches purchase

explorers_ring_1.rune_free_low_alchemy: 30 casts per day; no Magic experience outside the Alchemist's Playground.

explorers_ring_2.cabbage_patch_teleport: Three daily teleports to the cabbage patch near South Falador Farm.

explorers_ring_3.cabbage_patch_teleport: Unlimited teleports to the cabbage patch near South Falador Farm.

explorers_ring_4.rune_free_high_alchemy: 30 casts per day; no Magic experience outside the Alchemist's Playground.
other: Fairy rings do not require a Dramen or Lunar staff.
The seventh Slayer task-block slot is unlocked.

records.modeling_boundary: The current account schema has no daily-use or location state. Claiming the current ring and the zero-charge hard-tier cabbage teleport are represented as actions; exact daily ring uses remain factual capabilities and are not simulated as unlimited repeat transitions.

records.name: Kourend & Kebos hard task and utility branches

requirements.claim_boundary: A claimed hard tier requires all easy, medium, and hard tasks. The modeled task milestones are necessary branches, not sufficient proof of a hard-tier claim.

accepted_access: A mounted Xeric's talisman in a player-owned house
xerics_heart_task.rng_boundary: A Xeric's talisman can come from qualifying lizardman drops; acquisition is random and never becomes a deterministic item grant.

monster_examine_task.task: Cast Monster Examine on a mountain troll south of Mount Quidamortem.

wyrm_task.task: Kill a wyrm in the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon.
wyrm_task.transition_boundary: The actual combat kill remains player-confirmed until a combat-readiness and encounter model can establish it without inventing a kill.

radas_blessing_3.claim: Hard-tier reward from Elise; it can be retrieved for free if lost.
radas_blessing_3.fishing: While equipped, 6% chance to catch two fish at once everywhere except Tempoross; the extra fish grants no experience.

ash_sanctifier.claim: Claimable from Tyss after the hard tier.
ash_sanctifier.behavior: When carried and charged with death runes, it automatically scatters demonic ashes from killed monsters for half normal scattering Prayer experience.
ash_sanctifier.per_ash: One charge is consumed for each automatic scattering.
ash_sanctifier.elite_change: A claimed elite Kourend & Kebos tier raises its automatic scatter experience to the full normal amount.

records.modeling_boundary: Rada's daily Mount Karuulm counter, fishing-proc roll, Ash sanctifier charge balance, and ash drops are not present in the account schema. They are recorded as factual capabilities, not converted into unrestricted actions, automatic XP, or item gains.
